description: After 18 months of trial and error, here is what actually works. How to know when your startup has run its course, and how to move on gracefully.

title: How to Evaluate AI Tools: A Framework for Teams
excerpt: Stop demoing and start measuring. Here is the scorecard we use for every AI tool evaluation.
description: I learned this the hard way. Stop demoing and start measuring. Here is the scorecard we use for every AI tool evaluation.

title: Kimi K2 Explained: Open Agentic Intelligence at Trillion Scale
excerpt: Moonshot AI shipped a trillion-parameter open MoE model that uses tools, writes code, and finishes multi-step jobs. A plain-English read of the architecture, the MuonClip optimizer, and the benchmarks.
description: A faithful, plain-English walkthrough of Kimi K2: a 1-trillion-parameter open Mixture-of-Experts model with 32B active params, the spike-free MuonClip optimizer, agentic RL training, and what its SWE-bench and reasoning scores actually mean for builders.

title: Inside Kimi K2 Thinking: How an Open Model Learns to Reason
excerpt: A 1T-parameter open model that thinks across 200-300 tool calls without losing the thread. Here is how it reasons, what INT4 training buys, the benchmark numbers, and the honest limits.
description: A faithful walkthrough of Kimi K2 Thinking: how a 1T-parameter open model reasons across 200-300 tool calls, what its INT4 training buys, the benchmark numbers, and the honest limits.

title: Kimi K2.6 for Coding: What the Benchmarks Actually Show
excerpt: Moonshot open-sourced a model that beats GPT-5.4 on SWE-Bench Pro. A benchmark-first read of where Kimi K2.6 leads, where it trails, and how to point it.
description: A benchmark-first review of Moonshot open-weights Kimi K2.6: the coding scorecard (SWE-Bench Pro 58.6, Terminal-Bench 66.7), how long-horizon execution got it there, where it falls short on competitive-programming and reasoning, and how to actually use it.

title: WorldVQA Explained: Measuring Atomic World Knowledge in MLLMs
excerpt: Moonshot AI 3,500-question benchmark asks every vision model one blunt thing: do you actually recognize what you see, or are you guessing? Frontier models stay under 50%.
description: A plain-English deep read of WorldVQA, Moonshot AI benchmark for atomic visual world knowledge. What it tests, how its accuracy and calibration metrics work, why top MLLMs fail the long tail, and what it means for builders shipping vision into products.

title: Attention Residuals, Explained — and the Teenager Who Co-Wrote It
excerpt: Moonshot’s new architecture lets each transformer layer choose which earlier layers to listen to — a ~25% compute win on Kimi Linear. One of its two lead authors is a high-schooler from Shenzhen.
description: A plain-English deep read of Attention Residuals (arXiv:2603.15031): why fixed residual accumulation dilutes deep transformers, how attention-over-depth and Block AttnRes fix it for a 1.25x compute advantage on Kimi Linear, and the open-source path that took co-first author Nathan Chen (Guangyu Chen) from Flash Linear Attention contributor to Moonshot AI while still in high school.
